name: io.github.CinianStudios/chain-receipt
title: Chain Receipt
description: Create and verify signed, Bitcoin-anchored receipts for AI calls.

tools.name: create-receipt
tools.description: Make an AI chat call through Chain Receipt and get a signed, Bitcoin-anchored receipt for it. Needs a Chain Receipt API key (send it as the Authorization bearer token when connecting). Returns the model's answer plus the receipt id, hash, signature and verify URL. One receipt per call, counted against the org's monthly quota like any proxy call.

messages.description: The chat messages to send to the model.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens in the model's reply.

provider_key.description: Provider API key for this call only. Omit to use the org's stored provider key.

customer_ref.description: Your own reference for this call, stored on the receipt.

tools.name: verify-receipt
tools.description: Check a Chain Receipt: recomputes the hash, verifies the Ed25519 signature, and reports the Bitcoin anchoring status. No API key needed — the same public check as the verify page. Pass receipt_id, or the full receipt envelope.

receipt.description: The full receipt envelope object instead of receipt_id (for receipts not in the ledger).

receipt_hash.description: The claimed receipt hash, for the envelope form.

signature.description: The receipt signature, for the envelope form.

prompt.description: The original prompt text, to re-check the prompt commitment (needs salts).

response.description: The original provider response JSON, to re-check the response commitment (needs salts).

salts.description: The salts returned with the receipt (base64, prompt + response).

anchor.description: The envelope's anchor block (merkle_proof + merkle_root), to check a receipt not in the ledger.
